passages.title: The Shirt of a Happy Man
passages.body: Long ago, there lived a king who had everything. He had power, wealth, and a grand palace. But the king was not happy. Day after day, he felt grey and sad. He called in many doctors, but none of them could help. One day, a wise doctor said, "To make the king happy, find the shirt of a truly happy man. The king must wear it." So the king's men looked everywhere. At last, they found a happy man. He was singing in a field. "Are you really happy?" they asked. "Yes, I am the happiest man alive," he said. But when they asked for his shirt, they were surprised. The happy man had no shirt at all!

passages.title: The Winning Team
passages.body: Peter was new on the soccer team. He felt like there was a heavy weight on his shoulders because he had let his team down. In the last game, he had missed an important goal, and his team had lost. He was afraid the coach would kick him off the team. After the game, the coach called Peter in. "It's not your fault," the coach said. "We win and lose as a team." His teammates nodded in agreement. "You have the courage to keep trying," said his friend. "That's what makes you a good player." Peter felt a great sense of relief. He realized that real friends pull together. They do not let each other down.

passages.title: What Makes Us Happy?
passages.body: What makes people happy? Many people think that money and fame make us happy. But this is not always true. A rich banker may have wealth, but he can still feel sad and lonely. Studies show that good friendships make us happier than money. When we are with friends, we feel relaxed and warm. Helping others also makes us happy. The more we give, the more joy we feel. Doing things we love, like music or sports, makes us feel alive. So happiness does not come from things we own. It comes from the people we love and the things we enjoy. True happiness is found in the heart, not in the wallet.

passages.title: How Music Affects Us
passages.body: Music has a strong effect on our feelings. Different kinds of music make us feel different things. Soft, quiet music can make us feel calm and relaxed. It can help us sleep or study better. Fast, loud music can make us feel excited and full of energy. It is great for sports or parties. Sad music can even make some people cry, but it can also help them feel better afterwards. Happy songs make us want to dance and smile. Music can also bring back memories. A song from our childhood can make us think of the past. This is why music is such an important part of our lives.

passages.title: A True Friend
passages.body: Holly and Amy had been friends for years. But lately, they had not been getting along. Amy felt that Holly was leaving her out. Holly always spent time with her new friends. One day, Amy decided to talk to Holly rather than stay angry. "I feel hurt when you leave me out," Amy said. Holly was surprised. "I'm sorry," she said. "I didn't mean to make you feel that way. You are still my best friend." The two girls talked for a long time. In the end, their friendship was stronger than before. Amy learned that a true friend will talk about problems, not run away from them.

passages.title: Friendship Week Notice
passages.body: FRIENDSHIP WEEK IS COMING! Friends make our lives better. This week, let's celebrate our friendships! MONDAY: Write a thank-you card to a friend. Tell them what makes them special. TUESDAY: Have lunch with someone new. It is a good way to make new friends. WEDNESDAY: Help a classmate with their work. Helping others makes us both happy. THURSDAY: Share a happy memory with a friend. Good memories pull us together. FRIDAY: Play a team game. Remember, we win and lose as a team. Let's make this a week full of kindness. After all, a life with good friends is a happy life!
